companies.name: NVIDIA Corporation

business_description.text: NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing to help solve the most challenging computational problems.

shares_outstanding.notes: Shares outstanding from the 10-K cover page (sum of share classes if more than one).

competitive_advantages.text: Full-stack platform: GPUs, networking, systems and the CUDA software ecosystem that developers build on (workshop interpretation of the 10-K business section).
A large developer ecosystem around CUDA can raise switching costs for customers (workshop interpretation, not a company statement).
With our introduction of CUDA in 2006, we opened the parallel processing capabilities of our GPU to a broad range of compute-intensive applications, paving the way for the emergence of modern AI.

risks.text: Over the past three years, we have been subject to a series of shifting and expanding export control restrictions, impacting our ability to serve customers outside the United States.
Three direct customers accounted for 25 %, 18 %, and 13 % of our accounts receivable balance as of January 25, 2026.
We utilize foundries, such as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited, or TSMC, and Samsung Electronics Co.
Revenue depends heavily on data-center and AI infrastructure spending cycles; a slowdown in customer capex would hit growth (workshop interpretation).
Market expectations may already price in continued growth; valuation cannot be judged without a current share price (workshop interpretation).

companies.name: Systems Limited

business_description.text: Systems Limited is a public limited company incorporated in Pakistan under the Companies Act, 2017. The Company is principally engaged in the business of software development, trading of software and business process outsourcing services.

market_snapshot.notes: Snapshot captured when the dataset was built. P/E (TTM) as published by the portal, based on unconsolidated financials.

competitive_advantages.text: Software development and business process outsourcing services can grow with client demand without heavy fixed assets (workshop interpretation).

risks.text: Check how much revenue is earned in foreign currency in the latest annual report: PKR/USD moves affect reported results (not quantified in this dataset).
IT services depend on retaining skilled staff; wage pressure can compress margins (workshop interpretation).
